source:
The Products are to be used as a component of general production
equipment or for commercial use or industrial application ("General
Industrial Use").

source: MISUMI will notify the Customer of sales campaigns, provide purchasing support materials, such as catalogs and sales tools, and communicate other changes related to sales by email or message.

source: In the event that the Customer requests not to receive such information, MISUMI will stop sending it to the Customer.

source:

to the Customer are different.

source:
Please be aware that the Products
may not be delivered within the delivery period set out in the Catalog
due to transportation factors such as weather, traffic jams, or road
construction, the timing of the delivery (such as New Year holidays,
Christmas holidays, or other holidays), the inventory status of the

liable to the Customer in any way.

source:

are delivered to the place registered by the Customer or designated by
the Customer at the order.

source: Article 13 Credit Limit Amount
target: Điều 13. Hạn Mức Công Nợ

source: MISUMI may at its discretion, take any of the following ways if the total price for the Products ordered by the Customer exceeds the Credit Limit Amount or if otherwise necessary with respect to the Credit Limit Amount.

use as a component of general production equipment or for commercial use or industrial application, but does not include transportation devices with
